design.dependencies: Zod plus a type-only PlaybackPlan import; no application or infrastructure imports.
design.failureBehavior: Studio HTTP 200 with malformed or invalid JSON becomes API_CONTRACT_MISMATCH/502; playback plan parsing returns null and consumers fail closed; multipart consumers stop before subsequent requests or PUTs.
design.compatibility: Existing endpoints and URLs are unchanged; response schemas accept additive DTO fields.

limits: Playback and authenticated Studio pipeline were verified through a running local Next.js HTTP process and disposable PostgreSQL; authenticated Studio multipart upload with a real R2/S3-compatible service was not exercised, so K21-T1 remains partial.

Focused negative tests cover malformed reservation/list responses and invalid enums; full browser/runtime client matrix and second-person review remain partial, so K21-T2 is locally covered but the package is not formally closed.
No separate reviewer; R21 is not marked closed.

review.scope: Independent pass over K21 boundary schemas and their callers after initial implementation.
findingsFixed: Malformed 200 response while resuming a saved multipart upload cleared local resume state and immediately created a new reservation; fallback now occurs only for explicit ORIGINAL_NOT_FOUND or UPLOAD_NOT_OPEN.
Pipeline original.status accepted any non-empty string; it now validates the complete VideoOriginalStatus enum in admin and Studio schemas.
review.remaining: Live authenticated Studio multipart upload against a real S3-compatible/R2 service remains for Claude/server acceptance; no independent second-person review.
